notes: A freight charge of 185.00 is added after the subtotal. It is recorded in the shipping field, so subtotal (2,755.00) + tax (192.85) + shipping equals the total (3,132.85). Tax is charged on the subtotal only, not on the freight. The freight must NOT appear as a line item. A client may instead want it captured as a line item, in which case the line_items count would be 5 rather than 4.
